description: Use when: what tokens just launched on Base, and are they risky? Newest launches on Base (Uniswap, Aerodrome, Bankr, launchpads), up to 20, risk-checked at request time: Sourcify verification, upgradeable proxy, owner type, mint/pause/blacklist/fee functions, and a flag for copycats of USDC, ETH, BTC etc. B20 native tokens are labeled as not checkable by bytecode. Plus pool DEX, age, liquidity, FDV and 1h buys/sells. Data: GeckoTerminal. Heuristics, not an audit. Costs $0.01.
name: base_launch_feed
